name: whatsapi
description: Send WhatsApp messages from your own numbers, read and answer your chats, and send sign-in codes.

interface.longDescription: whatsapi.sh links your own WhatsApp numbers the way WhatsApp Web does, and lets your agent use them. Read a chat and answer it, send a message, photo, file or location, send and check sign-in codes, see whether a phone is on WhatsApp, and pair a new number with a QR code. Messages to people who haven't written in the last 24 hours wait in a queue and leave a few minutes apart, which keeps the number from sending like a machine.
capabilities: Send messages, media, locations and contacts
Pair a WhatsApp number and check its status
